'''Ven-Kav''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Venaari]]. It was the location of the local [[Imperial Command Center (Venaari)|Imperial Command Center]], the [[Binary Bar]], and [[Ven-Kavi Starport]]
